eyebrow: Physical: RMAN copies the actual files
code:
RMAN> BACKUP DATABASE PLUS ARCHIVELOG;

-- Block-level copy of datafiles, control files,
-- and archived redo logs.
-- Restore + apply redo = point-in-time recovery
-- of the ENTIRE database.
caption: RMAN is the disaster-recovery backbone — whole database, any point in time.
